operators.customDisplayName: Load all sheets from data/biomedical/input/1-s2.0-S0092867420301070-mmc3.xlsx and concatenate into one DataFrame with a column '__sheet' containing the sheet name.

Filter rows where __sheet == 'D-SE-acetyl' OR Description/Sheet mentions 'acetyl' (case-insensitive); inspect columns Gene, ID, Feature, REF, Description for gene-like tokens, split on ; , | /, trim trailing site suffix after '-' (e.g., ZNF592-S460 -> ZNF592), deduplicate and return one gene per row as column 'significant_gene'.
Show value counts for columns Sheet, Description, and __sheet to inspect how acetyl information is recorded.

operatorProperties.code:
def process(load_biomed_xlsx):
    df = load_biomed_xlsx
    cond = df['__sheet'].astype(str).str.contains('acetyl', case=False, na=False) | df['Description'].astype(str).str.contains('acetyl', case=False, na=False)
    return df.loc[cond, ['__sheet','Description','Gene']]
